creator: Alexander Terp
description:
On a touch device, loading `/item?id=...&view=article` fresh (a reload, or a shared link) opens the comments instead of the article, and the URL loses `view=article`.

`useCoarsePointer` returns its server snapshot, `false`, during hydration (`lib/use-coarse-pointer.ts:33`). `ItemView` has an effect that strips `view=article` for mouse users (`app/item/item-view.tsx`, "A mouse user landing on ?view=article"). That effect runs after the hydration commit, when `coarse` is still `false`, so it removes the param before the client re-renders with the real value.

Seen 2026-11-07 in Playwright with iPhone 13 emulation: `matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)")` was true, yet the URL ended up as `/item?id=50399933` with the comments shown. Tapping the Article tab after load works, since that happens after hydration.

Fix direction: don't act on `coarse` until the client snapshot is in, for example by having the hook report "unknown" during hydration.
title: article view: ?view=article dropped on fresh load
